# Close

`GRADED` `READ-ONLY` `STATEFUL` `AUDIT-TRAIL` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `TIE-CHECKED`

A stateful month-end checklist for one period. Generates tasks from the client's close calendar, tracks status across sessions, and names the skill that fits the next open task. Tracks and suggests — it runs nothing and posts nothing.

## Why these badges

- **`STATEFUL`** — Re-reads CHECKLIST.md fresh each session; if conversation and checklist disagree, the checklist wins.
- **`TIE-CHECKED`** — A task with a tie-check is only done when that check was green — 'ran it' is not 'tied'.
- **`HUMAN-APPROVAL`** — Never invokes another skill. You pick and run every step.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Where it comes from | If it's missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | **yes** | argument (YYYY-MM) | most recent unclosed month |
| `CLOSE-CALENDAR.md` | **yes** | client workspace | none — stops and suggests /onboard-client |
| `closes/&lt;YYYY-MM&gt;/CHECKLIST.md` | no | close workspace | generated on first run |
| `evidence artifacts` | no | closes/&lt;YYYY-MM&gt;/ — rec proofs, tie-out schedules, flux commentary | you report task status verbally |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| CHECKLIST.md | markdown | closes/&lt;YYYY-MM&gt;/ — tasks, status, due dates, evidence links |
| status report | chat | done / in progress / blocked, with dates relative to today |
| next-move shortlist | chat | open tasks whose dependencies are met, each named to a skill |
| close summary | markdown | adjustments posted, items carried forward, accepted exceptions with a why |

## What it will not do

- Run another skill.
- Post an entry.
